t: BWT Power Crystals Central Heating Protector is an effective inhibitor designed for all wet central heating systems. This powerful solution, in a convenient 32.5g sachet, protects against scale and corrosion, crucial for plumbers maintaining residential heating systems. A single dose treats systems up to 150Ltr, ensuring optimal heating system efficiency and reducing system noise. Ideal for both new and existing closed-loop installations, helping to prolong system life and maintain performance.
b: Single Dose Treats Systems up to 150Ltr
